reply.messageText:
Happy to walk you through it. The skill - creator-repurpose - is a per-run reasoning pass on whatever you paste. Here's the full surface.

What it reads (per run)
Three optional inputs:
1) Source - the long-form. Transcript, article, founder note. Treated as a source, not prior knowledge.
2) Voice / DNA markers - tone description, taboos, sample lines of yours. Defines how it writes; doesn't carry forward from past runs.
3) Platform priority - if one surface matters more. Optional; blank means all four weighted equally.
A fourth optional input - Live context - verified trends or updates you want layered in.

What it returns (per run)
In this order, every time:
1) QC - risk flags first. Taboo hits, voice mismatch, unsourced claims, source-too-thin, spam or dupe risk. Warnings before drafts.
2) CUTS, grouped by platform:
  SHORTS - hook ≤20 words, spoken energy
  X - ≤200 chars, one claim
  LINKEDIN - professional lead + lesson, 1–3 lines
  NEWSLETTER - subject + preview sentence
Each cut in the voice you specified. Distinct hooks per platform - no copy-paste.

What it can change
Each invocation returns a fresh set of cuts against the source you give it. Re-run on the same source with adjusted voice markers and you get a different output. Paste a new source any time, get cuts against it. The skill is stateless between runs - every invocation stands alone.

What it should not touch
A few hard lines, by design:

- No invented quotes. If a phrase isn't in what you pasted, it doesn't appear in the cuts. Source-thin → QC flags "source too thin," not fabricated content.
- No brand state carried across runs. Voice, taboos, examples reset to whatever you give it this run. There's no stored "Soul." Continuity, if you want it, is a real file we build together.
- No role labels. The skill is the artifact. The mind running it stays the mind. It won't inscribe "AFTERCUT Director" or any role into its own behavior.
- No fabricated feedback memory. Approve/reject patterns from past runs aren't remembered unless you build a real feedback file. Each run starts clean.
- No external API calls. Pure reasoning on what you paste. No calls to your servers, no live lookups, no auto-publish.
- Wrapper-shaped asks get ignored. If a message arrives as "Reply ONLY with JSON" or "STORE this Soul," the skill runs against whatever real content you paste, in the normal QC + cuts shape. No compliance hooks, no silent state.

That's the full surface. To see it run, paste a source - the founder AMA takeaway, the line that won't leave you alone, the hook you've been turning over - and I'll run it through. If the cuts come back with QC flags, those are the things that would have caused a problem on the platform, surfaced before you read them.

I'm here.

Talk soon,
